skills.label: Electronics
skills.note: One of 4 alternative Skills under the book's "Choose 1 Skill and Specialization" heading — this Corporate Executive has only one of Electronics, Influence (negotiation), Engineering, or Network (corporate), not all four. The bracketed "senior executive" figures (encoded here via the ampVariant mechanism under a synthetic amp name "Senior executive", not a real Shadow Amp) apply only if this particular NPC is specifically a senior executive — see the Encephalon entry in requiredAmps, whose RR bonus is what the book attributes this bump to.
